author: Aniket Samanta
text:
🎯 Aspiring Software Engineer | Backend & AI-ML Enthusiast | Open to Opportunities

During my AI/ML internship at CSIR-CBRI Roorkee, I got the chance to build something I'm genuinely proud of — a RAG-based document intelligence chatbot that helps users semantically search through massive policy documents instead of manually digging through files.

A few things that made this project special for me:

📌 Combined FAISS + ChromaDB for fast, accurate semantic retrieval
 📌 Built the entire backend on Spring Boot, keeping the architecture clean and scalable
 📌 Added RBAC so access stays secure across different user roles
 📌 Containerized everything with Docker and deployed live on AWS EC2
 📌 Tested rigorously — ~3,000 test cases, landed at 90–95% accuracy
 📌 Also built the React (Vite) frontend, so I got to work across the full stack

Beyond this, I've worked on FoodLens, integrating LLM APIs to turn raw ingredient data into human-readable health insights — because I love finding ways to make AI genuinely useful, not just impressive.

Currently in the final stretch of my MCA (Gurukul Kangri Vishwavidyalaya), and actively looking for full-time roles in Software Engineering, Backend Development, or AI/ML where I can keep building things that solve real problems.

If your team is hiring, or you know someone who is — I'd really appreciate a connection or referral 🙏
